title: USB 3.2-style link layer: header packets with CRC-16 and link control word, data packet payloads with CRC-32, link commands (LGOOD, LCRD, LRTY, LBAD), header sequence numbers, retry buffer, credits and the pending/credit timers, on an 8b/10b-like symbol interface

fields.desc: physical link up (U0): starts the advertisement; clearing it drops the link (receive state and credits reset; unacknowledged packets are kept and sent again)

regs.name: TX
regs.desc: Packet byte to send; one write per byte, LAST on the final byte. Bytes 0-11 are the header (byte 0 bits 4:0 = 01000 makes it a data packet, whose bytes 12 on are its payload); a packet is cut after 12 + MAXD = 44 bytes. The core takes bytes while one of its TXN = 4 retry buffers is free, link up or not

regs.name: RX
regs.desc: Received packet byte (head of the core's receive buffers); reading it pops it. Headers are delivered as 12 bytes, a data packet's payload after its header; a data packet whose payload failed is delivered as its header with ERR set. A credit is returned as each packet is read

fdesc.rx_err: the packet's payload failed (bad CRC-32, aborted with EDB, framing, too long): only its header is delivered

irqs.name: RECOVERY
irqs.desc: the link needs recovery (sequence error, protocol error, a third LBAD in a row, or a timer expired): the core stops until CTRL.LINK_UP is cleared and set again

irqs.name: ERR_HP
irqs.desc: a header packet failed (CRC-16, link control word CRC-5, or a K symbol inside): an LBAD is sent and headers are ignored until LRTY

irqs.name: ERR_SEQ
irqs.desc: a header packet with the wrong sequence number

irqs.name: ERR_LC
irqs.desc: a link command with both copies failing their CRC-5

irqs.name: ERR_DPP
irqs.desc: a data packet payload failed (CRC-32, EDB, framing, too long)

irqs.name: ERR_FRAME
irqs.desc: a framing error (K symbol out of place, broken ordered set)

irqs.name: ERR_PROTO
irqs.desc: a link command out of place: an LGOOD out of order, an LCRD with the wrong letter or too many, an LBAD with nothing sent

irqs.name: ERR_OVERFLOW
irqs.desc: a good header packet with no free receive buffer: dropped, not acknowledged

irqs.name: LBAD
irqs.desc: an LBAD was received: unacknowledged packets are sent again

notes: tx_sym / tx_k and rx_sym / rx_k are the symbol interface (one 8-bit symbol per clock, K flag for SHP FB, SDP 5C, END FD, EDB 7C, SLC DC, EPF F7); they pass through unchanged.
The core parameters MAXD (32), TXN (4 retry buffers), RXN (4 receive buffers), PEND_TO (400) and CRED_TO (2000) keep their defaults.
